description: This Java class represents a custom shipping region with properties like region name, associated countries, and shipping quote items. It includes methods for setting and retrieving these properties, as well as converting the object to a JSON string.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuotesRegion
classes.description: Model class representing a custom shipping region with JSON serialization capabilities.

methods.name: setQuoteItems
methods.description: Sets the list of shipping quote weight items for the region.

methods.name: getQuoteItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of shipping quote weight items.

methods.name: setCountries
methods.description: Sets the list of country codes associated with the region.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves the list of country codes.

methods.name: setCustomRegionName
methods.description: Sets the custom name for the region.

methods.name: getCustomRegionName
methods.description: Retrieves the custom name of the region.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Converts the object into a JSON formatted string representing the region.
